audit_scope: Read-only all Version 2 saved predictions/manifests; no raw dataset, old holdout, model fitting, or Version 1 result reads.

champion.recommendation: Highest adopted-design mean Macro F1. Retain as strongest recorded procedure, practically tied with standard capped SMOTE; not proven statistically superior.
interpretation_caveats: Headline standard deviation and variance use ddof=0, consistent with saved project summaries. Sample ddof=1 values are provided separately; neither is a confidence interval.

The arithmetic mean of per-class fold-mean F1 exactly reconstructs reported mean fold Macro F1. A summed confusion matrix reconstructs pooled repeated OOF F1, a different aggregation. Both must be labelled separately.
10,870 OOF rows represent 1,087 distinct development wines each predicted in ten repetitions, not 10,870 independent observations.
Repeated folds overlap in training and reuse observations: fold SD is split variability, not a standard error or confidence interval.

The nested result estimates inner selection of capped sampler profile/k within the protected-Tomek procedure. Final full-development fit is an artifact of the procedure; it does not obtain a new independent validation score.
Across-study model-family selection repeatedly consulted the same development validation. Report as development-CV estimate subject to model-selection optimism, not fresh external validation.
No raw-data duplicate/target-feature inspection was performed by this read-only metrics audit; parent audit must address feature-identical rows and data lineage.
champion.deployment_recipe_selection_note: The proposed final recipe is chosen by aggregate already recorded inner scores (gentle k=1) without new search. This deterministic final artifact selection differs from refitting the inner search anew on all development data; its exact fixed-recipe CV performance has not been separately estimated. Retain the nested procedure score as provenance, never as direct validation of the frozen fixed artifact.

validation_design_comparison_note: CV stability LDA+SMOTE 5-fold x10 has Macro F1 0.370179 versus adopted4x10 0.363380. Fivefold design was rejected for poorer rare-class validation support; choosing it now for higher score would cherry-pick validation. Champion ranking uses pre-adopted4x10.
